entries.title: II Corinthians 9:1
segments: ¶Now concerning the ministering to the saints, it is superfluous for me to write to you;

entries.title: II Corinthians 9:2
segments: for I know your willingness, about which I boast of you to the Macedonians, that Achaia was ready a year ago; and your zeal has stirred up the majority.

entries.title: II Corinthians 9:3
segments: Yet I have sent the brethren, lest our boasting of you should be in vain in this respect, that, as I said, you may be ready;

entries.title: II Corinthians 9:4
segments: lest if [some] Macedonians come with me and find you unprepared, we (not to mention you!) should be ashamed of this confident boasting.

entries.title: II Corinthians 9:5
segments: Therefore I thought it necessary to exhort the brethren to go to you ahead of time, and prepare your generous gift beforehand, which [you had] previously promised, that it may be ready as [a matter of] generosity and not as a grudging obligation.

entries.title: II Corinthians 9:6
segments: ¶But this [I say]: He who sows sparingly will also reap sparingly, and he who sows bountifully will also reap bountifully.

entries.title: II Corinthians 9:7
segments: [So let] each one [give] as he purposes in his heart, not grudgingly or of necessity; for God loves a cheerful giver.

entries.title: II Corinthians 9:8
segments: And God [is] able to make all grace abound toward you, that you, always having all sufficiency in all [things], may have an abundance for every good work.

entries.title: II Corinthians 9:9
segments: As it is written: "He has dispersed abroad, He has given to the poor; His righteousness endures forever."

entries.title: II Corinthians 9:10
segments: Now may He who supplies seed to the sower, and bread for food, supply and multiply the seed you have [sown] and increase the fruits of your righteousness,

entries.title: II Corinthians 9:11
segments: while [you are] enriched in everything for all liberality, which causes thanksgiving through us to God.

entries.title: II Corinthians 9:12
segments: For the administration of this service not only supplies the needs of the saints, but also is abounding through many thanksgivings to God,

entries.title: II Corinthians 9:13
segments: while, through the proof of this ministry, they glorify God for the obedience of your confession to the gospel of Christ, and for [your] liberal sharing with them and all [men],

entries.title: II Corinthians 9:14
segments: and by their prayer for you, who long for you because of the exceeding grace of God in you.

entries.title: II Corinthians 9:15
segments: Thanks [be] to God for His indescribable gift!
